statement: The Federal Open Market Committee leaves the federal funds target range unchanged at its scheduled meeting concluding 2026-09-16, keeping the range in effect on 2026-09-03.
resolution: The FOMC statement dated 2026-09-16 on federalreserve.gov states the target range for the federal funds rate is maintained at the range in effect on 2026-09-03; any increase or decrease resolves false.
failure_condition: The 2026-09-16 FOMC statement announces any change to the federal funds target range from the range in effect on 2026-09-03.
